    visited = [False] * n

        if visited[i]:
            continue
        
        # Start a cycle
        cycle = []
        j = i
        while not visited[j]:
            visited[j] = True
            cycle.append(j)
            j = p[j] - 1  # Move to the next element in the cycle
        
        # If the cycle length is odd, there's no solution

        for k in range(0, len(cycle), 2):
            q[cycle[k]] = p[cycle[k + 1]]
            q[cycle[k + 1]] = p[cycle[k]]
